name: Maps
description:
288 map questions: the 249-entry ISO country/territory baseline plus 39 named regional questions. France and Portugal ask their core geography; separately studied outlying regions retain all original land. Other composite ISO entries retain their overview. This is not a list of 288 countries. © Simon Pinkas. CC BY 4.0.

Maps drawn by Simon Pinkas from Natural Earth v5.1.2 (public domain), with McDonald Islands coastline from Geoscience Australia / Australian Antarctic Data Centre, 2020 (CC BY 4.0). Common place names adapted in part from Ultimate Geography 5.3, by the anki-geo contributors (text public domain). No Ultimate Geography pictures are included. © Simon Pinkas. Deck: CC BY 4.0.
